ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity pixels (~5-8%) appearing as localized white mottling and spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity background across both lobes. High-intensity contiguous pixel clusters (white) are concentrated in the lower-central region of the left lobe and as sparse, punctate dots across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an internal pixel-calculated angle of approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the central vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) along the trailing boundary. A distinct mid-lobe indentation (nick) is present on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex upward curve on both lobes, exhibiting an increasing positive slope that terminates in sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters located primarily in the medial-proximal region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, near-vertical high-intensity linear pixel disruption is visible on the lower lateral quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical white linear scar on the lower left lobe and a moderate irregular notch/amputation mark on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely acute and elongated distal tips (points) of the fluke lobes relative to the overall surface area.
